api_checks.description: POST /applications → 201 — payload carrying synthetic PAN, Aadhaar and salary-document content; the captured log buffer contains 0 occurrences of each of those three values
GET /products → 200 — sent with header X-Request-ID: req-abc; 100% of the log lines emitted while serving parse as JSON and each carries request_id equal to req-abc
GET /products → 200 — sent with no X-Request-ID header; every request-scoped log line carries the same generated non-empty request_id and the response echoes that id
GET /health → 200 — JSON body, and the measured response time is under 1 second
